sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:66

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:66:1
items.html:
All the three brains came to him through her. However, the brain in him that spreads into fifty gates, from her and of herself, enters the head of ZA, in the secret of the milk of his mother. And this is through Aba, who brought the Bina outside. Meaning, that even the brain of Hochma, which is from Aba, is not drawn to ZA except through Ima. However, the brain of Bina is drawn to him from the very self of Ima, through the nursing of the milk, whereby he attains the five Gevurot of Katnut [smallness/infancy] of Ima herself, which during the Ibur [impregnation] were like the horns of locusts, in the secret of the redness that he took from Ima; and through the nursing of the milk they grew. But the brain of Hochma comes to ZA from Aba, and only passes by way of passage through Ima. And these five Gevurot are the secret of the fifty gates of Bina, for every Gevura is composed of ten, and five times ten is fifty.
And this is what he says, “the brain that spreads into fifty gates, from her and of herself, enters the head of ZA” — namely the discernment of the Katnut of the bottom Hey in Einayim, called the five Gevurot of Katnut, which is the discernment of VAK lacking a Rosh [head]; and this he receives from the very self of the Katnut of Ima. And this is what he says, “and this is through Aba, who brought the Bina outside, in the secret of the closed Mem”: for the upper AVI are the secret of the Mem, they being the discernment of the six Sefirot from the Chazeh [chest] and above of AVI, called HBD HGT; and both of the upper AVI are regarded as the Yod of HaVaYaH, and as the discernment of Aba alone, as is known. And since he brought Ima outside, in the secret of the AHP that descend below the screen of the bottom Hey, the NHY of AVI are found to be outside his degree, and they became the discernment of VAK without a Rosh, which is the secret of the closed Mem, they being the four Sefirot from the Chazeh and below, called YESHSUT.
However, the beginning of the going out of Bina to the outside was made in the Rosh of AA; for through the correction of the bottom Hey in his Nikvey Einayim, namely in the concealed Hochma, he brought Bina outside his Rosh, to the discernment of the throat. But this Bina of AA is still not regarded as lacking a Rosh, for the reason that the GAR of Bina suffer no force of restriction whatsoever; and therefore the discernment of her GE, up to the Chazeh, which are the discernment of GAR, are still regarded as the discernment of Rosh. This is not so with her AHP, which are from the Chazeh and below: they already feel the force of the screen that is in the Peh [mouth] of AA, which brought Bina outside the Rosh; and therefore YESHSUT, who clothe there from the Chazeh and below of the upper AVI, are regarded as having already gone outside, and they became VAK without a Rosh. And that Katnut of YESHSUT, ZA receives through the Mochin of nursing. And this matter was explained at length above, page 879, the passage beginning “in Ima”; study it there well.
